title: Pretty curtain rod
text: Pretty curtain rod. This is a nice curtain rod.  I love the finials.  The color is pretty, I received aqua, the rod is silver.  They look great with the curtains.

product_metadata.title: Amazon Basics Decorative 5/8" Curtain Rod with Faceted Ball Finials, 48" - 86", Purple
features: Adjustable-length iron curtain rod with polyresin finial ends
5/8 inch rod diameter; for use with light to medium-weight curtains. Great for a child’s bedroom or playroom
Decorative finials at either of the rod add polished style and a balanced appearance
Expandable width to avoid obstructions or provide additional space between wall and window coverings
Comes with mounting hardware, including screws, anchors, and installation instructions
description: Amazon Basics Decorative 5/8" Curtain Rod with Faceted Ball Finials, 48" - 86", Purple
